title: TabKDE and Hybrid Models
summary: A research codebase extending the TabSyn tabular synthesis framework with new TabKDE and hybrid VAE/diffusion-KDE generative methods, evaluated against baselines using density, ML-efficiency, detection and privacy metrics. It calls sdmetrics' QualityReport, DiagnosticReport and LogisticDetection for evaluation, and imports sdv's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and metadata classes for tabular synthesis comparison.
